name: Hero
description: The page's opening section: optional eyebrow, heading, lead, action buttons and an image — beside the text, below it, or behind it as a full-bleed cover with a scrim.

layout.description: split: text and image side by side (stacked on phones); without an image the text takes the whole row. centered: centred text with the image below. cover: the image fills the section behind the text, darkened by a scrim; without an image it falls back to split.

tone.description: Section background (ignored by cover, which is always light text on the image).

align.description: Text position over a cover image (layout cover only): centred, as WordPress covers default to, or at the start edge.

leadAlign.description: The lead's alignment. inherit: as the layout sets it. start: at the start edge and across the column, under a centred heading (a centred heading widget over a left-aligned text editor in one container).

actionsAlign.description: The buttons' alignment. inherit: as the layout sets it. start: at the start edge, under centred text (a WordPress buttons block with no justification inside a centred cover).

width.description: Layout cover only. full: the image runs the full window width. content: the cover sits in the reading column, as a WordPress cover block that is not alignfull does under the page title.

headingScale.description: default: the layout's own type scale. theme: the heading takes the site's size for its level (`--text-heading-1` for the page-opening hero, `-2` otherwise), as the source's own h1 does under a block theme.

headingSize.description: The level whose site size the heading takes when it is not the level it is written at: h1 on an h2 heading keeps a source's second h1 at the h1 size under a page that keeps one h1. own: the heading's own level under headingScale theme, nothing otherwise. Any other value than own sets the size by itself.

heading.label: Heading
heading.description: The main heading (Cover/Group heading, Elementor heading, Divi header title).

level.description: Heading level: 1 when the hero opens the page, 2 when the page already has an h1.

href.label: Link
href.description: Where the button goes: a page on this site or a full address.

newTab.label: Open in a new tab
newTab.description: Open the link in a new tab (an external site the reader should not leave for).

style.label: Style
style.description: primary for the main action, secondary or ghost for the ones beside it.

image.label: Image

alt.label: Image description
alt.description: What the image shows, for readers who cannot see it; empty when it is decoration.

image.description: Hero image; loaded first (the page's largest image).

id.description: Anchor id of the section; the heading gets `<id>-title`.

minHeight.description: Layout cover only: the cover's own height in pixels, as the source sets it (520); absent, the layout's default.

measured.description: The source section's measured style (MeasuredStyle): frame width, padding, fill, image, columns per width, gap, text tone, radius, minimum height — all in pixels. Absent, the site's tokens; present, it wins over tone and columns. Values that are not a number, a colour or a known keyword are dropped.

color.description: Fill colour: hex, rgb(a) or hsl(a).

image.description: Background image address (http(s) or root-relative), drawn behind the content.

overlay.description: Colour or linear/radial gradient laid over the image or the fill.

size.description: cover, contain or auto; anything else draws as cover.

position.description: One or two of center/top/bottom/left/right or percentages.

columns.description: Item columns at 390 (base), 768 (md) and 1280 (lg) px; a missing width follows the narrower one.

tone.description: What the text is set for: dark = light text on a dark band. Without it, a fill's own lightness decides.

align.description: Where the heading and lead sit; read by a component whose own align is not set.

a11y: A labelled region (aria-labelledby the heading). One h1 by default; `level: 2` inside pages that already have one. The cover image is decorative when its alt is empty; text sits on an ink scrim for contrast.
